title.ja: 閉ざされた本道と、歪んだ真鍮
title.en: The Blocked Road and Deformed Brass

excerpt.ja: これで、わたしの届けてきたものは、四十三。
excerpt.en: With this, the number of people whose belongings I have returned is forty-three.

mood.ja: 指先が覚えている真鍮の冷たさと、行く手を阻む冬の気配
mood.en: The coldness of brass lingering on my fingertips, and the approach of winter blocking my way

title.ja: 官職録における未確認の一節
title.en: An Unverified Passage in the Directory of Officials

excerpt.ja: 『書記ミルテ、四時十七分、外壁に記述を残す』
excerpt.en: 'Scribe Milte, four-seventeen, leaves a description on the outer wall.'

mood.ja: 事実と筆跡の冷たい符合に、胸の奥が微かに軋む。
mood.en: The cold convergence of fact and handwriting causes a faint, silent ache deep within.

title.ja: 裏路地の風と、金貨二枚の沈黙
title.en: Alley Winds and the Two-Gold Silence

excerpt.ja: 五分間、ただ石を見つめて、それから音もなく去っていった。
excerpt.en: Without a word, she stared at that blue stone necklace for five whole minutes.

mood.ja: 人通りの絶えた角で、売れ残った馬蹄を撫でながら、自分の強欲さと臆病さに呆れている。
mood.en: Sitting in a deserted corner, stroking an unsold horseshoe, feeling exasperated by my own greed and cowardice.

title.ja: 裏腹の座金と保留された紙
title.en: The Contrary Washer and the Deferred Paper

excerpt.ja: 手元にある「あの誤鑑定書」の控えには、座金が逆に打たれていると明記されているはずだ。
excerpt.en: The copy of "that erroneous appraisal" in my possession explicitly states that the washer was driven in reverse.

mood.ja: 規約の条文をなぞる指先がわずかに冷える。三十年前の影が、大鑑定院の床下から這い出してくるようだ。
mood.en: My fingertips grow slightly cold as I trace the articles of the regulations. It feels as if a thirty-year-old shadow is crawling up from beneath the floor of the Academy.

title.en: The Silence of the Choked Stone

excerpt.ja: 声は言っていない。あの石は、ただ黙っていた。ウタが、その場をしのぐために適当な言葉を並べたのだ。
excerpt.en: The voice said nothing. That stone was merely silent. Uta had only spun convenient words to survive the moment.

mood.ja: 指先がこわばり、掌に骨櫛の尖った角が深く食い込んでいる。天幕の冷気が体を離れない。
mood.en: With stiffened fingertips, the sharp edges of the bone comb bite deep into the palm. The chill of the tent refuses to leave.

title.ja: 焼けた橋の灰と、二つの金属
title.en: Ashes on the Burnt Bridge and Two Pieces of Metal

excerpt.ja: ノヤ。その名を、指先が通り過ぎる。
excerpt.en: Noya. My finger passes over the name.

mood.ja: 冷たい風と、真鍮の指輪の重み
mood.en: The cold wind and the weight of a brass ring

title.ja: 四時十七分の木柱と、消えた石壁
title.en: The Wooden Post of Four-Seventeen and the Vanished Wall

excerpt.ja: この文字の彫り癖、肉筆のストローク、および字形の傾きを鑑定した結果、元同僚書記ミルテの筆跡と完全に一致した（確認）。
excerpt.en: Upon examining the carving habits, stroke tension, and slant of the characters, I found them to be an exact match to the handwriting of my former colleague, Myrte (Confirmed).

mood.ja: 事実と筆跡の冷たい符合に、胸の奥が微かに軋む。
mood.en: A cold alignment of facts and handwriting causes a faint ache deep in my chest.

title.ja: 倍になった値札と、消えた鍵の噂
title.en: A Doubled Price Tag and Rumors of a Lost Key

excerpt.ja: 金貨二枚。それが、あの青い石の首飾りの新しい値段。
excerpt.en: Two gold coins. That is the new price for the blue stone necklace.

mood.ja: 鍵を失くした師匠の噂と、一向に貯まらない頭金への焦燥
mood.en: Anxiety over the rumor of my master losing his key and the down payment that just won't accumulate.

title.ja: 削られた刻印と逆打ちの座金
title.en: Scraped Marks and the Reversed Washer

excerpt.ja: 師匠の過去の誤りと、兄の持ってきたこの燭台の繋がりについて、確証を得るには至らない。
excerpt.en: I cannot establish a definitive connection between my master's past error and the candlestick my brother brought.

mood.ja: 規約の暗唱でも抑えきれない、過去の暗部へ近づく恐怖と静かな興奮。
mood.en: A mixture of fear and quiet excitement as I approach the dark secrets of the past, uncontrollable even by reciting the Code.
